svg.aria-label: A ten-scene animation of one ammonia-free leaching run. An air pump above the vessel feeds oxygen down a pipe into the liquid. Oxygen dissolves gold from the board and also dissolves copper, which enters as copper(I). Oxygen re-oxidises that to copper(II), which can help dissolve gold but mostly converts thiosulfate into tetrathionate. Copper cycles round for ever, thiosulfate does not, and the run stops when the thiosulfate is gone with most of the gold still on the board.
